name: Fillout Free Forms
free_limit: Unlimited forms and seats with 1,000 responses/month on a forever-free hosted plan; includes multi-page forms, embeds, conditional logic and payments.
watch_out: The 1,000-response monthly cap applies to the Free plan; Starter and higher tiers increase allowances and enable paid-only customization and advanced features. Provider does not clearly specify payment-card and commercial-use requirements for the Free plan on its pricing page.
